raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner mistakenly included electrons in the calculation of atomic mass. Atomic mass is the sum of the number of protons and neutrons, as electrons have negligible mass. The Planner added 20 protons, 21 neutrons, and 20 electrons, resulting in an incorrect atomic mass of 61 instead of the correct mass of 41 (20 protons + 21 neutrons). This reflects a misapplication of atomic mass calculation principles and a flawed reasoning process leading to the wrong conclusion. The error matches patterns seen in similar cases, where the agent incorrectly sums all atomic particles instead of only considering protons and neutrons.
